name: Aehr Test Systems
blurb: Aehr Test Systems designs and manufactures wafer-level burn-in and test equipment for semiconductors, with a specialisation in silicon carbide (SiC) power devices, gallium nitride (GaN), and — increasingly — silicon photonics chips. Its flagship FOX-XP system stress-tests devices while still on the wafer, before costly packaging, identifying failures at the cheapest possible point in manufacturing. Aehr claims to be the first company to ship a multi-wafer burn-in solution for silicon photonics transceivers. The company is headquartered in Fremont, California.
recent: In March 2026, Aehr won a new silicon photonics customer for its high-power FOX-XP wafer-level burn-in system targeting hyperscale data-centre optical interconnects. Quarterly bookings reached $37.2 million in the quarter ending February 2026 — a book-to-bill ratio exceeding 3.5x — with the company guiding full-year FY2026 revenue toward the high end of its $45–$50 million range. Revenue in the same quarter was $10.3 million, down from $18.3 million a year earlier, reflecting a timing gap between order intake and shipment schedules weighted toward the second half of 2026.
